stem.text: An autocatalytic reaction is a reaction in which one of the products catalyses the reaction.
Which curve would be obtained if the rate of an autocatalytic reaction is plotted against time?

A.alt: Rate against time: rate rises steeply from zero, then levels off at a constant value.

B.alt: Rate against time: rate rises slowly from zero, then steeply, then levels off at a constant value (S-shaped curve).

C.alt: Rate against time: rate rises from zero to a maximum, then falls gradually.

D.alt: Rate against time: rate starts at its highest value and falls steadily, levelling off.
